title: Perun, Ult!
statementMd:
A lot of students spend their winter holidays productively. Vlad has advanced very well in doing so! For three days already, fueled by salads and tangerines — the leftovers from New Year celebration — he has been calibrating his rating in his favorite MOBA game, playing as a hero named Perun.

Perun has an ultimate ability called "Thunderwrath". At the instant of its activation, each enemy on the map ($*n*$ of them in total) loses ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/75515265b38bd0ce1a0e393838887f819e16dd63.png) health points as a single-time effect. It also has a restriction: it can only activated when the moment of time is an **integer**. The initial bounty for killing an enemy is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c09abf058cc34302de2b2f869144c78ea5395250.png). Additionally, it increases by ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7ca70a1269f4fb2d5e642ae2640c8b160d180b8f.png) each second. Formally, if at some second $*t*$ the ability is activated and the $*i*$-th enemy is killed as a result (i.e. his health drops to zero or lower), Vlad earns ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a2615a75f8ae58c44bfde6bd1c5a61c90e441fa7.png) units of gold.

Every enemy can receive damage, as well as be healed. There are multiple ways of doing so, but Vlad is not interested in details. For each of $*n*$ enemies he knows:

- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2cf419b0bba486e5c753ee73b93a9f100a2370fd.png) — maximum number of health points for the $*i*$-th enemy;
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e8df42255e7ef00f24914b3684c5df20be219104.png) — initial health of the enemy (on the $0$-th second);
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fc18a4258f1be5bf9c733bc4c06976dd1fe19e15.png) — the amount of health the $*i*$-th enemy can regenerate per second.

There also $*m*$ health updates Vlad knows about:

- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cd39c7ab837e084fbd8264aa933095076d50d6aa.png) — time when the health was updated;
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c6e598c4053cf2102b432e9d0a1cbad217cb8cbd.png) — the enemy whose health was updated;
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6b50ae119d0141bdb2e09660a8a4c76171270ed1.png) — updated health points for $*enemy*_{*j*}$.

Obviously, Vlad wants to maximize his profit. If it's necessary, he could even wait for years to activate his ability at the right second. Help him determine the exact second (note that it must be **an integer**) from $0$ (inclusively) to $+ ∞$ so that a single activation of the ability would yield Vlad the maximum possible amount of gold, and print this amount.

## Input

In the first line, two integers are given (separated by spaces) — $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$, $0 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{5}$).

In the second line, there are three integers: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c09abf058cc34302de2b2f869144c78ea5395250.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7ca70a1269f4fb2d5e642ae2640c8b160d180b8f.png) and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/75515265b38bd0ce1a0e393838887f819e16dd63.png) (![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7a0677908d8dbcdc1eeb0ab1d73e338edec6933c.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b7f3cd6910e07a56ef5d6032f6a07045630c788f.png)).

Each of the following $*n*$ lines has three integers — ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2cf419b0bba486e5c753ee73b93a9f100a2370fd.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e8df42255e7ef00f24914b3684c5df20be219104.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fc18a4258f1be5bf9c733bc4c06976dd1fe19e15.png) (![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5c99a1d66c3873f726dcbdd31ccc11ab434acd7f.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/562c03425e280f73c09e3cc1f7bd0e6144db6fcb.png)).

The next $*m*$ lines contain three integers each — ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cd39c7ab837e084fbd8264aa933095076d50d6aa.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c6e598c4053cf2102b432e9d0a1cbad217cb8cbd.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6b50ae119d0141bdb2e09660a8a4c76171270ed1.png) (![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0b7f055147263f622e0486bb297d63a29ccac2a1.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a1ff2ee36d8e71e4c847302f330ef003fd032435.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1515e5bf703089adfd9bbd6223e775f96daded62.png)). It is guaranteed that there is no more than one hearth change per second for each enemy: more formally, for each $*a*, *b*$ so that $1 ≤ *a*, *b* ≤ *m*, *a* ≠ *b*$ holds that if ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d22eb81beda434b0da26b5407d7a55356c2c5556.png), then ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/98bf5652f389882e84a2334bde50343daa179d9d.png).

## Output

Output the single integer — the maximum amount of gold Vlad can obtain if he applies "Thunderwrath" exactly once, or `-1` if this amount can be **infinitely** large.

## Note

On the pictures you can see health points of each enemy versus time in sample cases.

*Periods when Vlad can kill one enemy are marked with yellow color.*

*Periods when Vlad can kill two enemies are marked with purple color.*

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8d07bce48b180c381b955c8798576be282315164.png)

In the first sample case, Vlad can activate the ability at the $50$-th second: the enemies $2$ and $3$ will die since they would have $40$ and $50$ health points correspondingly. Vlad will earn $2·(1000 + 50·10) = 3000$ gold.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7ce4689927cb09da0a0eff42e441b28e06433239.png)

In the second sample case, the maximum amount of health for the enemy $1$ is less than the damage dealt by the ability. Hence, the enemy could be killed anytime. As the bounty increases by $50$ over the time, the maximum possible amount of gold is infinite.
statementZhMd:
许多学生都会充实地度过寒假。Vlad 在这方面进展得非常顺利！三天来，他一直靠着新年庆祝活动剩下的沙拉和橘子补充能量，在自己最喜欢的 MOBA 游戏中使用名为 Perun 的英雄校准自己的评分。

Perun 拥有一个名为“Thunderwrath”的终极技能。在技能激活的瞬间，地图上的每个敌人（总共有 $*n*$ 个）都会受到一次性效果，损失 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/75515265b38bd0ce1a0e393838887f819e16dd63.png) 点生命值。该技能还有一个限制：只能在时刻为**整数**时激活。击杀一个敌人的初始赏金为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c09abf058cc34302de2b2f869144c78ea5395250.png)。此外，赏金每秒增加 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7ca70a1269f4fb2d5e642ae2640c8b160d180b8f.png)。形式化地说，如果技能在某个时刻 $*t*$ 被激活，并且第 $*i*$ 个敌人因此被击杀（即其生命值降至 0 或以下），Vlad 将获得 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a2615a75f8ae58c44bfde6bd1c5a61c90e441fa7.png) 单位的金币。

每个敌人都可能受到伤害，也可能被治疗。实现这些操作有多种方式，但 Vlad 并不关心具体细节。对于 $*n*$ 个敌人中的每一个，他知道以下信息：

- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2cf419b0bba486e5c753ee73b93a9f100a2370fd.png) —— 第 $*i*$ 个敌人的最大生命值；
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e8df42255e7ef00f24914b3684c5df20be219104.png) —— 敌人在第 $0$ 秒时的初始生命值；
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fc18a4258f1be5bf9c733bc4c06976dd1fe19e15.png) —— 第 $*i*$ 个敌人每秒能够恢复的生命值。

此外，Vlad 还知道 $*m*$ 次生命值更新：

- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cd39c7ab837e084fbd8264aa933095076d50d6aa.png) —— 生命值更新发生的时刻；
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c6e598c4053cf2102b432e9d0a1cbad217cb8cbd.png) —— 生命值被更新的敌人；
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6b50ae119d0141bdb2e09660a8a4c76171270ed1.png) —— ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c6e598c4053cf2102b432e9d0a1cbad217cb8cbd.png) 的更新后生命值。

显然，Vlad 希望使自己的收益最大化。必要时，他甚至可以等待数年，在合适的时刻释放技能。请帮助他确定从 $0$（包括）到 $+ ∞$ 之间的准确时刻（注意，该时刻必须是**整数**），使得只释放一次技能时 Vlad 能获得尽可能多的金币，并输出这个金额。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数（以空格分隔）—— $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$，$0 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{5}$）。

第二行包含三个整数：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c09abf058cc34302de2b2f869144c78ea5395250.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7ca70a1269f4fb2d5e642ae2640c8b160d180b8f.png) 和 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/75515265b38bd0ce1a0e393838887f819e16dd63.png)（![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7a0677908d8dbcdc1eeb0ab1d73e338edec6933c.png)，![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b7f3cd6910e07a56ef5d6032f6a07045630c788f.png)）。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含三个整数——![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2cf419b0bba486e5c753ee73b93a9f100a2370fd.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e8df42255e7ef00f24914b3684c5df20be219104.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fc18a4258f1be5bf9c733bc4c06976dd1fe19e15.png)（![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5c99a1d66c3873f726dcbdd31ccc11ab434acd7f.png)，![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/562c03425e280f73c09e3cc1f7bd0e6144db6fcb.png)）。

接下来的 $*m*$ 行中，每行包含三个整数——![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cd39c7ab837e084fbd8264aa933095076d50d6aa.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c6e598c4053cf2102b432e9d0a1cbad217cb8cbd.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6b50ae119d0141bdb2e09660a8a4c76171270ed1.png)（![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0b7f055147263f622e0486bb297d63a29ccac2a1.png)，![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a1ff2ee36d8e71e4c847302f330ef003fd032435.png)，![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1515e5bf703089adfd9bbd6223e775f96daded62.png)）。保证对于每个敌人，每秒最多发生一次生命值变化：更正式地说，对于满足 $1 ≤ *a*, *b* ≤ *m*, *a* ≠ *b*$ 的任意 $*a*, *b*$，如果 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d22eb81beda434b0da26b5407d7a55356c2c5556.png)，则 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/98bf5652f389882e84a2334bde50343daa179d9d.png)。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——如果 Vlad 恰好使用一次“Thunderwrath”，他能够获得的最大金币数；如果该金额可以**无限大**，则输出 `-1`。

## 说明

图中展示了样例中每个敌人的生命值随时间的变化。

*Vlad 可以击杀一个敌人的时间段以黄色标记。*

*Vlad 可以击杀两个敌人的时间段以紫色标记。*

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8d07bce48b180c381b955c8798576be282315164.png)

在第一个样例中，Vlad 可以在第 $50$ 秒激活技能：敌人 2 和 3 将会死亡，因为届时它们的生命值分别为 $40$ 和 $50$。Vlad 将获得 $2·(1000 + 50·10) = 3000$ 金币。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7ce4689927cb09da0a0eff42e441b28e06433239.png)

在第二个样例中，敌人 1 的最大生命值小于技能造成的伤害。因此，可以在任意时刻将其击杀。由于赏金会随时间增加，每秒增加 $50$，所以最大可能的金币数是无限的。
